Grace ordered rice and juice at the study app last night. On Tuesday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The forum banned the troll's sockpuppets.

Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The e-book shelf looked quieter than usual that evening. What's more, final sale items cannot be returned.

Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily advised Grace to try cooking as a new hobby. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. For example, in old Scots verse, mony is another word for many.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The study app has become an important part of daily life. Grace prefers rainy weather when running in the gym. She studies geomorphology, especially how rivers carve valleys over centuries.
Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The experience taught Grace more than any book could.
